tasks.short: Train recycling technicians and community service workers

steps.what: Find current safety and recycling operations reference material
Prepare training materials and local recycling examples
Deliver the safety and recycling operations training
Observe practice and correct unsafe or misunderstood recycling actions

tasks.design: Reuse approved training sections and a topic index in {DOCS}. The coordinator adapts local examples and teaches and observes practice personally; there is no automated safety instruction or new completion log.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current procedures and recreating standard teaching sections take preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document tools support indexed references and reusable material sections.
tasks.still_hard: Different trainees and hazardous materials require direct observation and adaptation.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator sees misunderstandings and corrects unsafe practice.
tasks.altitude: Prepare training efficiently while preserving practical teaching.

reach.learn: Which procedures trainees struggle to apply

evidence.claim: Reusable document sections can shorten preparation, but the local time benefit and availability of suitable material are unmeasured.

assumptions: Training preparation and actual materials are included. No attendance certificate, competence record or activity log is invented when the current operation does not keep one.

The coordinator identifies trainee needs during s1 and s2. The procedure owner produces current approved procedures through existing document control; revision and local applicability checks remain in s1. Unknown revisions require the existing manual search.
Native topic indexing removes two of10 reference hours. Reusable standard teaching sections remove seven of20 preparation hours; 13 hours remain for local examples, changes and checking.

For a mixed audience including outside community service workers, the instruction steps use external authority; purely internal technician sessions are internal communication. Neither gate is an additional approval stage for saving materials.
unknowns: How much suitable approved training material already exists
research_questions: Can existing sections be reused without extensive changes for the actual material streams and trainee group?

already_counted.description: Reference checking and local adaptation remain in s1 and s2.

incremental.description: Coordinator updates reusable sections when procedures change.

approvals.approved_version: Actual explanation and demonstration checked against current procedures and local hazards immediately before delivery; changes require a renewed check.
Actual corrective instruction checked for the observed practice and equipment before speaking or demonstrating; changed conditions invalidate it.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R91, gross9 less focal upkeep1 gives net8. Low0 retains all preparation when approved reusable sections are unavailable and no new configuration is adopted. High5 retains nine reference hours and15 material-preparation hours, plus70 teaching/practice hours: R94, less1 upkeep. Central retains eight reference and13 preparation hours when topic and material compatibility are good.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate opportunities for collecting and recycling materials

steps.what: Gather material volumes, current outlets and collection constraints
Investigate possible materials and acceptance requirements with potential partners
Assess feasibility, contamination risk and value of the recycling opportunities
Write the opportunity comparison used to select further investigations

tasks.design: Use saved material views in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {SPREADSHEET}, then reuse the existing option-comparison layout in {DOCS}. The coordinator investigates real outlets, assesses suitability and writes the actual findings; the design makes no promise to find new viable markets automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing material evidence and standard comparison headings may be recreated for each investigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Saved operational views and a reusable option layout can reduce that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Acceptance terms and contamination tolerances depend on the material and partner.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator tests whether a nominal opportunity is practically and commercially credible.
tasks.altitude: Keep investigation evidence comparable while retaining partner exploration and feasibility judgement.

reach.learn: Which acceptance conditions make an option unworkable

evidence.claim: Saved views and a reusable comparison layout may reduce repetitive evidence preparation; the benefit is an unmeasured design estimate.

assumptions: An existing opportunity comparison is the working artefact used by the coordinator to choose further investigations. No extra record of every conversation, formal approval or report send is added.

Existing collection staff produce material descriptions and quantities in ordinary operations. The coordinator checks those fields in s1, obtains new acceptance conditions in s2 and writes those conditions in s4; capture time is counted. Missing or incomparable material descriptions require manual evidence gathering.
Native saved views remove three of20 evidence-gathering hours. A comparison layout removes five of20 formatting and repeated-heading hours; actual findings and uncertainty writing remain15 hours.
No product capability from the digest demonstrates automatic discovery or acceptance of new material streams, so the design remains E1.
unknowns: Whether current records distinguish commercially meaningful material grades
Whether a comparison artefact is kept today
research_questions: Which current comparison sections are repeatedly recreated rather than requiring new investigation?

already_counted.description: Evidence checking, partner investigation and written findings remain in s1, s2 and s4.

incremental.description: Coordinator maintains material-view filters and comparison headings.

approvals.approved_version: Actual partner question, disclosed material information and exploratory statement checked before speaking; no commercial commitment is authorised and new statements require renewed checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R92, gross8 less upkeep1 gives net7. Low1 retains all20 gathering hours where material grades cannot be compared and18 writing hours where only headings can be reused, plus60 investigation/assessment hours: R98, net1. High5 retains18 gathering and16 writing hours with partially comparable evidence: R94, net5. Central retains17 gathering and15 writing hours; actual market investigation remains full in every case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assign drivers and technicians to recycling routes

steps.what: Check routes, staff availability and required driving or technician qualifications
Choose truck driver and recycling technician assignments for each route
Write the chosen assignments into the route roster
Check and communicate the final route assignments to staff

tasks.design: Put route context from {OPS_SYSTEM} beside native availability information in {HCM}, and reuse recurring route-roster rows for writing the coordinator's decisions. The coordinator chooses assignments and checks the exact version communicated through {CHAT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Separate availability checks and repeated roster entry add work before assignments reach staff.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and recurring roster rows can reduce clerical preparation without automated personnel allocation.
tasks.still_hard: Last-minute absence and route-specific practical constraints still require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator knows when a nominally qualified assignment will not work safely.
tasks.altitude: Reduce route-roster administration while retaining allocation decisions.

reach.learn: Which routes require unusual staffing combinations

evidence.claim: Logistics workforce software supports schedule and availability functions; the design does not use automated behaviour-based allocation.
Reusing roster rows is an unmeasured clerical-saving assumption, not a route-mileage saving.

assumptions: Route creation is outside this allocation task; checking route requirements, choosing staff, writing the actual roster and communicating it are included.

The planner produces route identifiers and operating requirements, staff declare availability and personnel administration maintains qualification records in existing work. The coordinator validates those references in s1; manual contact for missing fields is retained within20 hours. No free ready-to-assign flag is assumed.

Native context views remove five of25 navigation hours. Reusable roster rows remove12 of30 rewriting hours while retaining18 hours for real changes and checks. Ordinary author saves remain in s3 without self-approval.
Assignments remain human decisions. No algorithmic staffing score, machine send or implied alert is proposed.
unknowns: How often route rosters recur unchanged
Whether availability is current at assignment time
research_questions: What roster-entry work remains on routes with substitutions or special qualifications?

already_counted.description: Context validation and actual roster entry remain in s1 and s3.

incremental.description: Coordinator maintains recurring roster rows after route changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact route/date, staff identities, duties, shift times and recipients checked before communication; changed assignments invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R83, gross17 less upkeep1 gives net16. Low4 retains24 context hours and26 entry hours when last-minute substitutions prevent most row reuse, plus45 decisions/send: R95, net4. High11 retains22 context and21 entry hours with partly recurring routes, plus45 other hours: R88, net11. Central retains20 context and18 entry hours for compatible recurring rosters.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create and manage recycling operations budgets

steps.what: Gather recycling volumes, costs, revenue terms and actual spending
Choose budget assumptions and responses to spending differences
Calculate recycling budget lines and actual-to-budget differences
Write the budget explanation and proposed operating responses
Review budget calculations and explanations for correctness and feasibility
Check the final budget version and send it to finance

tasks.design: Use native actuals and volume views in {ERP} and {OPS_SYSTEM}, with a checked formula workbook in {SPREADSHEET}. Reuse the existing budget layout in {DOCS}; the coordinator chooses assumptions, reviews the result and checks the actual finance send through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated extraction, arithmetic and layout preparation obscure the assumptions that need attention.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and ordinary spreadsheet formulas can reuse consistent units and periods.
tasks.still_hard: Recycling prices and operating demands are uncertain and require scenario judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator distinguishes feasible operational responses from numerical targets.

ambition.what: Revisit the operating budget when material prices or volumes materially change.

tasks.altitude: Maintain transparent budget assumptions with less repetitive arithmetic.

reach.learn: Which collection costs depend on actual operational constraints

evidence.claim: Native actuals views, checked spreadsheet formulas and reusable budget layouts can reduce clerical budget work; the task-specific benefit is unmeasured.

assumptions: The budget and its operating explanation are current working artefacts read by finance. This design includes their actual preparation and send, without inventing a new approval or payment stage.

Finance produces ledger actuals, operations produces collected volumes and commercial staff maintains agreed terms in existing processes. The coordinator checks period, material grade, units and term dates in s1 and captures new assumptions in s2; this work remains. Missing fields are manually sourced before formulas run.

Native views remove four of20 retrieval hours, formulas remove20 arithmetic hours, and the existing layout removes six of20 formatting/repeated-context hours. Actual explanation writing and budget review remain full where judgement is required.
No ERP posting, procurement commitment, out-of-range alert or automatic distribution is implied. Ordinary workbook saves stay within retained work without a self-gate.
unknowns: Whether current budgets already use reliable formulas
Consistency of units across material grades and ledger periods
research_questions: Can the formula workbook reproduce a prior budget and its explanations from comparable actuals and captured assumptions?

already_counted.description: Source checking, assumption setting and result review remain in s1, s2 and s5.

incremental.description: Coordinator maintains mappings and checks formulas after unit or budget-line changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact budget period, scenario, figures, explanation, workbook version and finance recipient checked before sending; edits invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R70 (source16+assumptions25+writing14+review10+send5), gross30 less upkeep2 gives net28. Low12 retains20 retrieval,10 manual calculation and16 writing hours where units and budget lines are partly incompatible, plus40 other hours: R86, net12. High21 retains18 retrieval, four manual calculation and15 writing hours with a few unmapped grades, plus40 other hours: R77, net21. Central assumes compatible fields and formula coverage; no generic percentage reduction sets the bounds.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep recycling training, partnerships, staffing and budgets grounded in practical operations while reducing repeated preparation.
skills_to_grow: Separate staffing decisions from roster entry
role.ambitious_version: A recycling coordinator who can investigate credible options and update operating plans without rebuilding the same documents and calculations.
